# Bhawani Technologies

> Delhi NCR's #1 Waterproofing Company & Industrial Flooring Specialists.

## Core Services
- Roof Waterproofing (APP Torch-on Bitumen Membranes, PU Liquid Coatings, Cool Roof Heat Proofing)
- Terrace Waterproofing (Crack Filling, Tile Terrace Sealing without Demolition, Brick Bat Coba Rehabilitation)
- Basement Waterproofing (PU Injection Grouting, Crystalline Concrete Waterproofing, Sump Drainage)
- Bathroom Waterproofing (Under-tile Membranes, Epoxy Tile Grouting)
- Water Tank Waterproofing (Food-grade Non-toxic Cementitious & Epoxy Linings)
- Industrial Epoxy Flooring (Self-leveling Epoxy, Anti-static ESD Flooring, Polyurethane Coatings)

## Approved Material Standards
- Dr. Fixit (Pidilite): Roofseal, 301 Pidicrete URP, 302 Super Latex, Newcoat
- Asian Paints SmartCare: Damp Proof, Damp Proof Ultra
- Fosroc Chemicals: Brushbond, Nitoproof, Conbextra
- Sika India: SikaTop Seal 107, SikaBit T-140 SG
